messages:
Zoe (Design): dropped a tiny mock + notes for batch input validation -> vectors preview -> export mapping. Main asks: how to surface row-level validation errors, keyboard shortcuts for quick selects, and clearer export field mapping names. GIF: https://rwd-assets/vec-validate-clip.gif Tom (Eng): saw it. we can attach validation errors per row and show an inline icon with tooltip. for persistence: keep selected ids even if user fixes error and row reflows. Irene (PM): good. UX: validation icon should be tappable to open a compact panel with the error and suggested fixes. Also allow bulk "+Fix all" when the same issue repeats. Sam (Accessibility): accessibility notes: the validation icon must be keyboard-focusable and announce the error via aria-describedby. Example pattern: ```
Missing vector values. Click to see fix suggestions.
``` Zoe (Design): copy idea for mapping modal: instead of "Columns" label use "Export fields" and show friendly names vs raw keys (e.g., "Customer note -> customer_note"). Add a small preview row that shows the serialized output sample. Tom (Eng): implementation: mapping modal returns an array of {label, key}. We'll send keys to backend but show labels in UI. For preview sample we'll serialize first 3 rows client-side. For large uploads, sample may differ but it's just illustrative. Irene (PM): keyboard shortcuts request: support 'Space' to toggle focused row, 'A' to select all visible, 'Shift+A' to select all across pages, and '/' to focus filter search. Document these in the modal footer. Sam (Accessibility): caution: single-letter shortcuts must be discoverable and avoid collisions. Add a small help popover (question mark) listing shortcuts and ensure they can be turned off in settings. Also make sure shortcuts are disabled when typing in inputs. Zoe (Design): UX for invalid rows: show a faint red row stripe and a small inline message "Invalid: missing embedding" with a link "How to fix" opening the compact panel. Also add a bulk action on the top bar: "Fix visible errors" that runs heuristics. Tom (Eng): heuristics we can try: re-run embedding for empty rows if text present, fall back to default embedding model for rows missing model tag, or surface a CSV download of invalid rows for manual fix. We'll put limits on auto-fix attempts. Irene (PM): export mapping copy: top of modal: "Export fields & preview"; below that show: "Output keys will be: customer_note, vector, score" then sample. Add a small toggle: "Use friendly names as headers" (on by default). Sam (Accessibility): modal accessibility: move focus to first input when opened, trap focus, add role="dialog" aria-modal="true", and ensure the sample preview table uses role="grid". Announce when mapping saved via aria-live. Zoe (Design): agree on friendly headers by default. For errors banner: "12 rows invalid. Fix now or download invalid rows" with a clear primary CTA and a secondary "Download CSV". Tom (Eng): backend: export job accepts selected_ids[], mapping_keys[], use_friendly_headers boolean, and fix_attempts flag for bulk fixes. If fix_attempts=true we'll attempt auto-fix heuristics and include a fix report in job metadata. ExportBot: Validation summary: 12 invalid rows found. Export job will skip invalid rows unless "Fix attempts" selected. Irene (PM): acceptance checklist I'll add: inline validation panel, bulk fix action, keyboard shortcuts help, export mapping friendly headers, preview sample, aria announcements for errors and saves. Zoe (Design): thanks team. i'll update mock with validation panel, mapping modal sample, keyboard help popover, and error banner. Posting v2 in ~2 hours :sparkles: Tom (Eng): i'll wire a storybook fixture for the mapping modal + keyboard shortcuts. Ping when v2 is up.
